subject: Newbiw question: How do I stop/exit the server?

messages.author: bd25043bfb8df933
messages.subject: Newbiw question: How do I stop/exit the server?
parts:
Hi,

I just started following the tutorial but am wondering how to exit an example:

> library(shiny)
> runExample("01_hello")
Listening on port 6377

This opens a new Chrome tab, but even if I close the tab, R does not return to the prompt. Ctrl-c does not work either. I have not seen anything in the mailing list or tutorial indicating how to get back to the prompt.

Thanks!
Fabian

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Newbiw question: How do I stop/exit the server?
parts: If  you use RStudio or the standard R GUI for Windows, there is a Stop button or you can also press Esc.
